headline: fleet mean fade rate 0.887 %/yr across 166 modules
method: linear regression of (Pmp / Nameplate_Pmp) vs exposure_days, slope × 365 × 100
comparison_to_literature: Published c-Si module degradation: 0.5-1.0 %/yr (Jordan & Kurtz 2013 meta-review). Fleet median above this range = unusually fast-fading population; below = unusually stable. PV-IV-EL is intentionally a stress-tested cohort.
